Embeddings request against real OpenAI API

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let request_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"input":["Hello world"],"model":"openai/text-embedding-3-small"}"#).unwrap();
    let request = serde_json::from_value(request_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("OPENAI_API_KEY").expect("OPENAI_API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.embed(request).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
}
```
